tagline.en_US: Run the TDengine TSDB service in one LXC with persistent data and logs.

description.en_US: TDengine is an open-source time-series database designed for the Internet of Things, connected vehicles, and industrial telemetry. It provides real-time data ingestion, querying, and storage optimization for massive streams of metric data generated by sensors and collectors. The system includes built-in caching, stream processing, and data subscription features to simplify data workflows and analytics.
